## Purpose

Assess whether the current evidence shows that the Lead Lab Option B increment meets the approved acceptance boundary. This run updates the acceptance matrix and exceptions after the latest local build evidence. It does not accept the deliverable, close gaps, assign owners, change scope, approve production readiness, or treat deferred work as complete.

## Acceptance Boundary

The assessment covers every approved in-scope requirement in the current acceptance matrix. It records the current status of `RQ-17 (embedded-video URL protection)`, `RQ-18 (Microsoft 365 SSO should be used for the new application)`, and the approved Classroom changes. Local evidence is distinguished from staging and launch acceptance.

## Tailoring Decision

| Factor | Project evidence | Effect on rigor |
|---|---|---|
| Criticality | The application protects participant content and is targeted for availability before 2026-09-11. | Acceptance evidence remains required. |
| Scale | The product and delivery team are small, but the MVP spans access, classroom, community, calendar, administration, security, and operations. | Standard traceability remains sufficient for this increment review. |
| Duration | The schedule is short and Gate 1 is deferred to later. | Use a compact matrix with explicit retest triggers and no invented dates. |
| Complexity | Authentication, participant data, staging, operations, video behavior, and approved Classroom changes affect acceptance. | Record unresolved conditions instead of treating missing evidence as a pass. |
| Approach | Delivery is iterative from a local vertical slice toward staging. | Validate the current increment without treating it as the complete MVP. |
| Authority | The requester and IT team prepare and test; the LeadLab Director gives final launch acceptance. | Keep acceptance, closure, ownership, baseline, and production decisions outside this draft. |

## Minimum Output

1. Updated acceptance matrix for the approved Option B requirements.
2. Evidence status for the newly validated local increment, staging, participant, and operational checks.
3. Explicit exceptions for unresolved requirements and deferred work.
4. Acceptance authority, proposed process metadata changes, proposed ACT-08 (Run and record manual browser playback and responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile workflow tests) state update, and next trigger.

## Authority Boundary

Alson may assess evidence and prepare proposed records. Alson may not accept the deliverable, close related items, change the agreed scope, assign owners, revise a baseline, resolve the authentication or participant-data decision, pass Gate 1, or approve production readiness. The PM must separately approve Stage 05 before any canonical record changes.
